verdict.rationale: Docusign documents a supported MCP connector enabling Claude, Gemini CLI, and Copilot Studio to query agreement status/metadata and trigger IAM workflow actions via natural-language commands, plus AI-powered chat interfaces for contract review and summaries. This directly shows natural-language operation of core agreement workflows through agentic integrations. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user verification of the MCP connector's reliability and breadth of NL command coverage beyond vendor blog examples.
